meta.name: coding-agent-sessions
meta.description: MUST USE when asked to find, read, list, search, inspect, fetch, export, or reconstruct coding-agent sessions across Codex, Claude Code/Desktop, OpenCode, OMO/Senpi/pi, oh-my-pi (omp), gajae-code (gjc), OpenClaw, Factory Droid, Amp, Gemini/Kimi/Qwen CLIs, Codebuff, Roo/Kilo/Cline, Kodu, Cursor CLI, Aider, Aside browser-agent sessions, or unknown local agent logs. Covers transcripts, session IDs, rollout JSONL, state SQLite, Claude projects/pre-compact histories, OpenCode messages/parts, child/subagent linkage, cwd/model/time/token filters, archives, and cost clues. Expands fuzzy recall into parallel query lanes and first probes known stores so absent platforms are skipped cheaply. Triggers: coding agent sessions, Codex/Claude/OpenCode/OMO/Senpi/pi/oh-my-pi/omp/gajae-code/gjc/OpenClaw/Droid/Amp/Kodu/Cursor/Aider/Aside sessions, transcript search, session history, session ID, read transcript, token usage, subagent sessions, what did I do yesterday, did we already do this.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 搜索并导出各编码助手的会话记录
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果常用多个 AI 编码助手，却总想不起上次怎么写的。
copy.tagline_en: Search and export past conversations from coding assistants
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often lose track of what you did with AI coding tools.

howto.what: 装上后,当你想找回以前用 AI 编程助手干过的活,Claude 会先在电脑里搜索这些工具的本地记录,而不是只凭记忆回答。它能列出、读取和比对不同工具的会话,给出会话 ID、时间、模型、消息摘要等,还能显示子任务。
howto.when: 当用户要求查找、读取、检查本地编程助手的会话记录,如“我昨天干了什么”“是不是已经做过这个”等回忆性问题时触发。

say.text: 我昨天用 Codex 和 Claude 都干了什么?
say.note: 它会并行搜索这些工具的本地记录再汇总。

say.text: 帮我找出上周修 OpenCode 那个 bug 的会话。
say.note: 它会扩展多个搜索词,并包含子任务记录。

say.text: 读一下这个会话 ID 的完整记录和 token 用量。
say.note: 它会读取原始文件并展示子会话链接。

howto.what_en: This skill makes Claude search local agent session logs first, then list/find/read sessions across many tools. It outputs JSON with platform, ID, times, model, prompt previews, subagent links, and can open raw files as evidence.
howto.when_en: Fires when users ask to find, read, or inspect local coding-agent sessions, including fuzzy recall like 'what did I do yesterday' or 'did we already do this'.

say_en.text: What did I do yesterday with Codex and Claude?
say_en.note: Searches all local platform stores in parallel.

say_en.text: Find the session where we fixed the OpenCode bug last week.
say_en.note: Expands query lanes and includes subagents.

say_en.text: Show the full transcript and token usage for this session ID.
say_en.note: Reads raw files and reveals child sessions.
